summary: The candidate for cycle 33563418289 does NOT fix the V2-07 release blocker. The only delta versus the pristine accepted tree (d717169) is release-log.txt, the 2240-line failed-run log from Actions run 33552750352: no product code, configuration, script, workflow or smoke script was modified. Trusted verification passed (exit 0; reports/audits/TRUSTED_33563418289.md: npm ci, npm run check 608 tests/16 suites, expo install --check, expo export, expo prebuild, gradlew assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL). Independent checks confirm the root cause of the release failure: the ReactiveCircus/android-emulator-runner action (rev a421e43855164a8197daf9d8d40fe71c6996bb0d) executes each line of the release job's script: block as a separate 'sh -c' process (lib/script-parser.js splits by newlines; lib/main.js runs exec.exec('sh',['-c',line]) per line), so the shell variable package set on line 1 does not persist to the smoke-script invocation on line 3. The smoke script therefore receives an empty package argument and aborts with 'smoke-android-apk.sh: line 3: 2: package' (exit 1), failing the release job before the E2E golden path runs. This was reproduced locally (sh -c 'package="com.chorescore.v2"' followed by sh -c 'echo "Using validated Android package: $package"' prints an empty value) and matches the log evidence at 21:51:46. Because the workflow and .github/scripts/smoke-android-apk.sh are byte-identical to the pristine tree, the next trusted release attempt will fail identically. Decision: repair. The mustFix finding requires inlining the package value per line in the emulator script block (or making the smoke script fall back to app.json when $2 is empty, mirroring scripts/e2e-android.js configuredAndroidPackage()); both fixes live in the protected .github/** surface and must be applied by the trusted shell or with an explicit builder scope extension for the release script. Secondary non-blocking observations: release-log.txt is evidence only (harmless, but must not be mistaken for a repair), and the emulator booted only after ~636s without KVM, close to the action's default 600s boot timeout (flakiness risk for future release runs, not the current blocker).

findings.problem: The V2-07 release blocker from Actions run 33552750352 is not fixed. The ReactiveCircus/android-emulator-runner action executes each line of the release job's script: input as a separate 'sh -c' process, so the shell variable package set on line 1 ('package="${{ steps.contract.outputs.package }}"') does not persist to line 3, which invokes the smoke script with '$package' as its second argument. The smoke script receives an empty package and aborts on '${2:?package}' with 'smoke-android-apk.sh: line 3: 2: package' (exit 1), failing the release job before the Android golden path E2E can run. The candidate contains no fix: the workflow and the smoke script are byte-identical to the pristine accepted tree, so the next trusted release attempt will fail identically.

findings.requiredFix: Make each line of the emulator script block self-contained: pass '${{ steps.contract.outputs.package }}' directly to .github/scripts/smoke-android-apk.sh and to CHORESCORE_E2E_PACKAGE instead of relying on the $package shell variable (which does not persist across the action's line-by-line sh -c execution); alternatively make .github/scripts/smoke-android-apk.sh fall back to the package from app.json when $2 is empty, mirroring scripts/e2e-android.js configuredAndroidPackage(). Both fixes are in the protected .github/** surface: the repair must be applied by the trusted shell, or the builder scope must be explicitly extended to the release script for this repair.
